title: How much of an acquisitive borrower's term loan the credit committee can approve under its house limit
subdomain: other: obligor-group credit concentration and house-limit monitoring
prompt_shape: 01 (ranked list under a cap): six requests ranked by projected utilisation of the house limit, each with its 30 September book split, five quarter-end exposures, projection, utilisation and approvable amount

sources.origin: constructed for this task by task446/generator/make.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional UK bank (Calder & Wey Bank plc) and fictional borrowers, on the published GLEIF golden-copy CSV schemas (LEI-CDF 3.1, RR-CDF 2.1, reporting exceptions, ISIN-to-LEI) with valid ISO 17442 LEI and ISO 6166 ISIN check digits; managing LOU identifiers are real LOU LEIs; no real borrower, bank exposure or GLEIF record is depicted
